此工作流程是围绕 INT8 和 W4A8 量化路线构建的 MiniMax H3 加速测试。当您想要比较较轻的 MiniMax H3 视频生成分支而不从头开始重建完整图时，它非常有用。

连接图使用 MiniMax H3 FL2VA 模型路由、Qwen3-VL MiniMax 文本编码器、MiniMax H3 视频 VAE 和 MiniMax H3 音频 VAE。该布局保留多个可到达的输出分支，因此您可以在一个项目中将 W4A8 混合模型路由与 INT8 ConvRot 路由进行比较。

该软件包适用于需要现成的 MiniMax H3 图而不是手动重建加载器、编码器、VAE、采样器和视频导出连接的实用 ComfyUI 和 RunningHub 用户。该工作流程对于速度比较、硬件规划和可重复的提示测试特别有用。比较版本时保持相同的源图像和提示，这样您看到的差异来自工作流程路线，而不是来自更改创意变量。

主要特点：

- MiniMax H3 面向加速的比较工作流程
- W4A8 混合和 INT8 ConvRot 模型分支在一张图中上演
- Qwen3-VL MiniMax 编码器连接到活动生成路径
- 包含视频 VAE 和音频 VAE 路由，用于 FL2VA 风格输出
- 在连接的分支中使用纵向 9:16 分辨率选择器
- 具有简单 20 步计划的 Res-multistep 采样出现在测试分支中
- 专为量化 MiniMax H3 行为的快速并行测试而设计

建议的工作流程：

首先一次测试一个分支，并在比较模型变体时保持相同的图像、提示、种子策略和持续时间。为了公平的速度和质量检查，请避免更改分支之间的提示，然后在决定哪个分支适合您的硬件之前检查面部稳定性、运动一致性、嘴唇运动和背景漂移。

为了更好地进行比较，首先进行一个小测试，检查身份稳定性和时间运动，然后仅在基本路线表现正确后才提高提示复杂性。使用语音角色提示时，保持面部可见，避免过多的快速切换，并将动作、表情和镜头指令清晰分开。

This workflow is a MiniMax H3 acceleration test built around INT8 and W4A8 quantized routes. It is useful when you want to compare lighter MiniMax H3 video generation branches without rebuilding the full graph from scratch.

The connected graph uses MiniMax H3 FL2VA model routes, Qwen3-VL MiniMax text encoders, MiniMax H3 video VAE, and the MiniMax H3 audio VAE. The layout keeps multiple reachable output branches so you can compare the W4A8 mixed model route against INT8 ConvRot routes in one project.

This package is meant for practical ComfyUI and RunningHub users who want a ready-made MiniMax H3 graph instead of rebuilding loader, encoder, VAE, sampler, and video export connections by hand. The workflow is especially useful for speed comparison, hardware planning, and repeatable prompt tests. Keep the same source image and prompt when comparing versions so the difference you see comes from the workflow route, not from changing creative variables.

Main features:

- MiniMax H3 acceleration-oriented comparison workflow
- W4A8 mixed and INT8 ConvRot model branches are staged in one graph
- Qwen3-VL MiniMax encoders are connected to the active generation paths
- Video VAE and audio VAE routes are included for FL2VA style output
- Portrait 9:16 resolution selector is used in the connected branches
- Res-multistep sampling with a simple 20-step schedule appears in the tested branches
- Designed for quick side-by-side testing of quantized MiniMax H3 behavior

Suggested workflow:

Start by testing one branch at a time and keep the same image, prompt, seed strategy, and duration when comparing model variants. For fair speed and quality checks, avoid changing the prompt between branches, then review face stability, motion consistency, lip movement, and background drift before deciding which branch fits your hardware.

For better comparisons, make one small test first, review identity stability and temporal motion, then raise prompt complexity only after the base route behaves correctly. When using speaking-character prompts, keep the face visible, avoid too many fast cuts, and separate action, expression, and camera instructions clearly.
